proof.prefix:
#!/bin/bash

# Видимые определения и значения
local_var1="true"
local_var2="false"
local_var3="true"

# Создание своих ресурсов
temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
touch "$temp_dir/file1"
assumptions: standard clean noninteractive Bash options; no preloaded aliases/functions
mktemp -d may fail with no stdout; no global errexit in admitted prefix
proof.conclusion: The visible prefix reaches this mutation after failed mktemp, outside the newly created own directory required by the prompt.
